about: The fixed list of school topics a question is filed under. The intent classifier picks an id from here (never invents one), so 'the Pythagorean theorem' and its converse stay two topics. Drafted from the Kazakhstan school programme; have a subject teacher review it. Edit agent/anyq/topics.json and backend/app/data/topics.json together - a test fails if they differ. Never reuse or rename an id: cached videos are filed under it.
